environment.description: Same application deployed in namespace 'data-plane-prod'. Istio sidecar injection enabled with PeerAuthentication policy set to STRICT mTLS for the namespace. AuthorizationPolicy resource scoped to the stream-processor workload requires request principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/api-gateway/sa/gateway-sa' for paths prefixed with '/ws/'. Additionally, the Envoy sidecar has a custom Lua filter (applied via EnvoyFilter CR targeting the inbound listener on port 8080) that validates the 'X-Request-Nonce' header against a per-connection ephemeral nonce issued by the control-plane's token-vending service, with nonce TTL of 5 seconds and single-use enforcement via a shared Redis bitmap. The HMAC signing key is sourced from a Vault transit engine with auto-rotation policy 'rotate-every-60s' and the previous key version is immediately revoked (not just rotated) via a custom Vault plugin that calls DELETE /transit/keys/:name/versions/:version.

envoy_filter.validation: X-Request-Nonce header checked against Redis bitmap, TTL 5s, single-use
